findings.summary: The new read function is approximately 134 lines, exceeding the architect role's configured 50-line function threshold.
findings.evidence: lib/arch_tools/arch_functor_catalogue.ml:116 begins read; its schema/marker checks, header and provenance validation, JSON grammar validation, reference validation, and rendering preparation continue through line 249. This is the sole consumer-side contract boundary for FR-023 through FR-029 (specs/functor-instance-resolution.md:190-199).
findings.fix: Extract private, side-effect-free stages for marker/header validation, input validation, and application validation; preserve the existing one snapshot transaction in read and the current refusal precedence.

findings.summary: The new collect function is approximately 68 lines, exceeding the configured 50-line function threshold and combining traversal, descriptor construction, location normalization, and diagnostics policy.
findings.evidence: lib/arch_index/arch_index_functors.ml:56-123 contains the full Typedtree traversal and nested helper policy. The same function owns preorder identity (lines 75-85), shallow descriptor construction (lines 62-72), and diagnostics derivation (lines 102-115), which are distinct frozen contracts in specs/functor-instance-resolution.md:205-220.
findings.fix: Split pure descriptor/location/diagnostics construction from the traversal driver while retaining parent-first allocation and head-before-argument traversal order exactly.

findings.summary: Whole-catalogue validation rescans all decoded applications once per input, making the in-memory validation cost O(inputs × applications) before the requested limit can be applied.
findings.evidence: lib/arch_tools/arch_functor_catalogue.ml:232-235 folds the full decoded application list for every input; :236-244 filters and sorts that full list again for every input. Full validation before limit is required by specs/functor-instance-resolution.md:193-199, but this implementation’s repeated scans are not required by that contract.
findings.fix: Build a single artifact-keyed grouping/count map while decoding applications, then validate each input’s count, ordinal sequence, and forward references from its group. Keep whole-catalogue validation and output ordering unchanged.
